# static1.squarespace.com

> > A diverse content delivery network hosting resources for TV programming guides, online polling tools, news coverage, and reference materials.

This CDN serves content spanning entertainment scheduling (TV Guide), polling and survey platforms (Doodle, StrawPoll, Poll Maker, SurveyMonkey), political news coverage (NBC News, Fox News), and general reference materials. The content reflects a mix of real-time scheduling tools, user-generated polling interfaces, and curated entertainment recommendations.

## TV & Entertainment Guides

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): TV Guide homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV Guide listings page for TV schedules and channel information
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Daily live sports TV schedule with MLB, NBA, NHL, and soccer games
- [The 61 Best Movies on Netflix Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/best-movies-on-netflix): Curated list of 61 best Netflix movies including Jurassic World Rebirth
- [The 43 Best TV Shows on Hulu Right Now (March 2026) - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/best-shows-on-hulu): Guide to 43 best Hulu shows featuring Paradise and Scrubs revival
- [New Amazon Prime Video TV Shows and Movies in March 2026 - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/news/new-on-amazon-prime-video): March 2026 guide to new Prime Video releases featuring Scarpetta

## Poll & Survey Tools

- [PollCraft - Create Engaging Polls with Instant Real-Time Results](https://pollcraft.app): Homepage for PollCraft privacy-first polling app with real-time results
- [Create a Poll - Free Poll Maker - StrawPoll](https://strawpoll.com/create): StrawPoll poll creation interface with multiple poll type options
- [Make a Poll in Seconds | Free & Unlimited | Poll Maker](https://poll-maker.com): Poll Maker homepage featuring free unlimited polls with real-time results
- [Poll Maker: Create Free Quick Polls](https://surveymonkey.com/mp/online-polls): SurveyMonkey poll maker product page with templates and tips
- [Poll maker - easy to use - get results fast!  | Doodle](https://doodle.com/en/poll-maker): How-to guide for creating online polls with Doodle's poll maker tool
